Active authority is the July 11 staged plan, which is a proposal (`planned_not_installed`), not verified construction: the level-10 production cell uses one Stabilizer, one Nozzle, one Impeller, two Valves, one Turbine, and two Pumps; the second Stabilizer is later, before Scanner/levels 11–12, and one HRS v2 is reserved only if recovery testing justifies it. Since your ammunition and consumables are valuable, bank the excess if storage is reasonably close; otherwise advance methodically, retaining an abort route and enough supplies for recovery. The tagged Regeneration Chamber reduces travel after death but does not protect carried gear or guarantee a local respawn: a chamber was observed going offline when its base became corrupted, causing respawn at the starting launcher, but the universal disable rules and corruption threshold remain unverified. Starry Night is even lighter (about 1/5), with zero persistent hostile markers within 250 units, though roamers may enter. Clear wanderers, take the final chest first, and then loot debris. Its guaranteed final chest contains an Electronics Blueprint, Rotor Blueprint, 15 Armory Tokens, and a Frame Memory Module.
